SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS 22732T1
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
3116 North Oakley Avenue
From C1-2 to a B2-2

ai .
The subject property is improved with a residential building with two dwelling units and one
automobile parking space. The subject property is located on a block improved with buildings of
various heights that contain residential, commercial, and mixed uses—which consist of ground
floor commercial space with residential uses above. The subject property is in a Transit Served
Location per the Transit-Oriented Provisions of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance as it is located
within 1,320 feet from the Western Avenue CTA Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segment (49, X49,
49B).

The Project

The Applicant seeks to rezone the property to construct a three-story, three-unit residential
building with a two-car garage and three bicycle parking spaces. The height of the building will
be thirty-eight feet. To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks a change in zoning
classification for the subject property from a C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District to a B2-2
Neighborhood Mixed-Use District. The Applicant is also filing a Type 1 rezoning application and
seeks the following: 1) an administrative adjustment under 17-13-1003-EE to decrease the
number of automobile parking spaces to two spaces; and 2) a variation under 17-13-1101-R to
increase the sufficient area of the let by 10% to reduce minimum lot area standards and to allow
for three dwelling units.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 2,954.00 square feet

Floor Area: 5,317.20 square feet

Maximum FAR: 1.8

Residential Dwelling Units: 3

MLA Density: 984.67 square feet

Height: 38 feet

Automobile Parking: 2

Bicycle Parking: 3

Setbacks:
East (Front): 2.00 feet
North (Side): 3.33 feet
South (Side): 3.00 feet
Rear: 39 feet 3 inches
